stem.en: Which observation best supports the idea that sound is a mechanical wave?

text.en: Sound can be loud or soft.
Sound needs a medium to travel.
Sound comes from a vibrating object.

explanation.en: A mechanical wave needs a medium to travel. Sound cannot travel through a vacuum, so it is a mechanical wave. Being loud or soft, coming from a vibrating object, or carrying energy does not show that a wave needs a medium.

hints.en: Recall the meaning of a mechanical wave.
